`final class FrameThreadBridge`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IThreadBridge`](/reference/bridges/ithreadbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.thread` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FrameThreadBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/thread/FrameThreadBridge.java)

The default thread bridge of a backend, for which the thread that creates it draws while other threads queue their tasks.

## Description

[`Backend.register`](/reference/backends/backend/#Backend-method-register) creates it on the thread that registers the backend.
[`UIBridgeRegistry.frame`](/reference/backends/uibridgeregistry/#UIBridgeRegistry-method-frame) calls `runTasks()` at the start of every frame.

## Method details

<a id="FrameThreadBridge-method-isRenderThread"></a>

### isRenderThread

`boolean isRenderThread()` 

If `true`, the calling thread is the thread that created the bridge.

<a id="FrameThreadBridge-method-execute"></a>

### execute

`void execute(Runnable runnable)` 

Runs the task at once on the render thread; from another thread, queues it for the next `runTasks()`.

<a id="FrameThreadBridge-method-runTasks"></a>

### runTasks

`void runTasks()` 

Runs the queued tasks in order, including the tasks queued while it runs.
A task that throws a `RuntimeException` prints one warning per kind of failure, and the next tasks still run.
